news.title: News & updates
news.lede: What has changed in Hawkeye, newest first.
news.election-days-body: 16 January 2027: President, Senate and House of Representatives. 6 February 2027: Governorship and State Houses of Assembly.
news.n1-title: Photograph a big result poster in parts
news.n1-body: The result poster INEC pastes up at each polling unit (Form EC60E) can be too big for one clear photo. Observers can now take up to three photos of it, top to bottom, and the app joins them into one before it is signed.
news.n2-body: INEC's polling-unit directory now lists 453 more units, all in Delta State. Hawkeye's register, maps and unit search carry all 177,299.
news.n3-title: Counts read off the sheet photo, on the website too
news.n3-body: The website and Hawkeye Lite now suggest each party's count from the result-sheet photo, with the same reader as the app. The observer still checks every figure before sending.
news.n4-body: The not-for-profit that runs Hawkeye is registered with the Corporate Affairs Commission as Incorporated Trustees, IT No. 9958777.
news.n5-body: Follow the Hawkeye WhatsApp channel for updates about the app and the 2027 elections.
news.n6-title: Each race shows INEC's final list
news.n6-body: Each race now shows the parties on INEC's final list of candidates, so observers see only the parties on their own ballot. See all races.
news.n7-body: On the website and in Hawkeye Lite, "Near me" now works without a network once your state's units have downloaded.
index.get-involved-title: Help make every polling unit's result public
index.gi-observer-body: Photograph and sign the result at your own polling unit on election day.
index.gi-practice-body: Learn every step on a sample result sheet before election day. No sign-up needed.
index.gi-captain-body: Help the observers in your ward reach every polling unit, so no unit is left without one.
index.gi-partner-body: Civil-society groups, newsrooms and funders: write to us about working together.
support.nonprofit-body: Hawkeye is a free, nonpartisan programme of IniXien Hope Initiative, a Nigerian not-for-profit registered with the Corporate Affairs Commission as Incorporated Trustees (IT No. 9958777). It takes no political money and carries no advertising.
support.way-partner: Partner with us. Civil-society groups, newsrooms and universities can work with us on training observers and publishing polling-unit results.
support.way-fund: Fund the work. Grants and donations pay for the servers, the phones and the people who keep Hawkeye running.
support.way-observe: Volunteer. The most useful help of all is free: become an observer at your own polling unit on election day.
support.write-to-us: To partner with us or fund the work, write to info@hawkeye.com.ng, or see About & Contact.
support.never-ask-for-funds: Hawkeye will never message you asking for money, passwords or one-time codes.
about.funding-nonprofit: Hawkeye takes no political money and carries no advertising. Partners, funders and volunteers keep it running: Support Hawkeye →
